articles.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
articles.snippet: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

articles.title: Tokenized Tesla surges as Elon Musk unveils SpaceX-powered flying Roadster prototype
articles.snippet: Volume in Hyperliquid’s Tesla contract hit $47 million in one hour after Elon Musk’s flying Roadster demo, up from $2.8 million, with U.S. stocks closed.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin dips to $81,000 as stocks slide, VIX soars ahead of Black Monday anniversary
articles.snippet: A Friday surge in oil prices hit already-shaky equity markets, sending the Nasdaq down more than 2%.

articles.title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange already paid up, but a court order and restrictions from its 2025 settlement will not be lifted even though the CFTC said the case should have never been presented.

articles.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.
